segments.title: Hulk Hogan · run-in / confrontation
segments.result: Appeared on the big screen to distract Flair, then ran out with Jimmy Hart to clear the ring; told Okerlund he'd defend against Flair the next night if Flair had the guts
segments.context: Also in the segment: Jimmy Hart, Ric Flair, Terry Taylor, Gene Okerlund. Venue: Disney-MGM Studios, Orlando, FL.
